title: Brawl at the Palace
setup: November 19, 2004, Pacers at Pistons, a rematch of the previous season's conference finals. With about 46 seconds left and Indiana up 97-82, Ron Artest fouls Ben Wallace, who shoves him, and both teams confront each other. A fan throws a cup of beer that hits Artest on the scorers' table. He and teammate Stephen Jackson go into the stands, and Artest and Jermaine O'Neal swing at fans who rush the court.
question: How many games is Artest suspended?
options: The rest of the season, 73 games
ruling: The NBA suspended Artest for the remainder of the season, 73 games. Stephen Jackson got 30 games, Jermaine O'Neal 25, Anthony Johnson 5 and Ben Wallace 6. Other players got one game each for leaving their bench. The final 45.9 seconds of the game were never played.
rulebookNote: The source lists the suspensions by length but cites no specific rule.
